items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know he did Joe and John Farnsworth’s group...

ctx.x: At this time he was 78 or 79. He was born in 1922.

I believe so. He was up there. I got very worried. I said, “Cecil, please, there’s this thing called Meals on Wheels.” I said, “They deliver food to the house. Please, let me help you.” He goes, “I don’t need any help.” He got very upset. As I said, I made mistakes at first, and I guess I didn’t approach it delicately enough. He hung up. And I felt so terrible. Here was this guy I just was loving so much, and we got along beautifully, and then it just ended so abruptly. I was like, “Oh my God, what did you do?”…
For some years before that, he’d been going to Smoke, or Augie’s before that, playing with Eric Alexander and those folks...
